serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Shit! I knocked over some bottles laying around and they made a loud noise! I hope no one heard that or I might get into trouble!
Fuck, somewhere on third floor one of the windows just lit up!
???: You goddamn hobo! I told you many times that if I see you one more time going through my trash I will call for the cops!
Cops?! That’s the worst thing that could happen right now! Especially that I’m in a position of a highly illegal bot part!
